name: Tinker Med Pack passives: Enhanced Procedures and Emergency Circumvented (#1305, #1253)
contract: #1305, #1253: both passives are native spell modifiers and aura types, so neither needs a script. Enhanced Procedures 506819 (passive, DurationIndex 21) carries two ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) effects on EffectSpellClassMask (0,0,32768): MiscValue 1 SPELLMOD_DURATION BasePoints 99 DieSides 1 (+100%) and MiscValue 22 SPELLMOD_DOT BasePoints 74 DieSides 1 (+75%). Med Pack 502533 has SpellFamilyName 34, SpellFamilyFlags (0,0,32768), DurationIndex 32 (SpellDuration.dbc row 32 = 6000 ms) and effect 0 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL with Amplitude 1000, so the duration becomes 12000 ms and SPELLMOD_DOT turns a 1000 base tick into 1750. Emergency Circumvented 805303 carries ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 7 SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE BasePoints 14 DieSides 1 (+15) on mask (2147483648,0,0), which in family 34 resolves to the Emergency Heal rows (575027 has SpellFamilyFlags (2147483648,2,0)), plus SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT (286) on mask (0,0,32768), which makes Med Pack's periodic heal roll for critical hits. Native paths only: Player::ApplySpellMod, Aura::CalcMaxDuration, Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone (SPELLMOD_DOT for damagetype DOT), Unit::SpellDoneCritChance and AuraEffect::CalcPeriodicCritChance. Neither Med Pack nor Emergency Heal carries SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Med Pack keeps its 6 sec duration without Enhanced Procedures
Enhanced Procedures doubles Med Pack's duration to 12 sec
Med Pack rank 1 keeps its 6 sec duration without the talent
Enhanced Procedures reaches Med Pack rank 1 as well
Med Pack's periodic healing is unmodified without the talent
Enhanced Procedures raises Med Pack's periodic healing by 75%
Emergency Heal has no extra critical chance without Emergency Circumvented
Emergency Circumvented adds 15 points of critical chance to Emergency Heal
The Emergency Heal crit mask does not spill onto Med Pack
Apply Med Pack with the unmodified Tinker as its caster
Apply Med Pack with Enhanced Procedures as its caster
Apply Med Pack with Emergency Circumvented as its caster
The unmodified Med Pack aura lasts 6 sec
Enhanced Procedures makes the applied Med Pack aura last 12 sec
Med Pack still ticks once per second without the talent
Enhanced Procedures changes the duration, not the tick rate
Med Pack's periodic heal cannot crit without Emergency Circumvented
Emergency Circumvented lets Med Pack's periodic heal crit
